name: Hohenzollern Crypt Reopening at Berlin Cathedral
description: After six years and an €18 million restoration, one of Europe's most important dynastic burial sites reopens. The crypt holds 91 coffins and sarcophagi spanning five centuries of Prussian royalty, now returned to their historical arrangement with new climate control, barrier-free access, and an interactive exhibition. A free Open Day precedes the official reopening.
